text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Make a commercial!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want to make a commercial out of 
the way she runs with her instincts 
unleashed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Even if Tracen Academy has better 
facilities! And is state-of-the-art! And 
is a convenient place with no 
long-distance travel required!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Seeing someone running with such 
passion... Any Umamusume would surely want 
to run too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I get what you're trying to say, Chiyo. 
I think it's a good idea, too, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Running with your instincts unleashed is, 
how should I put it, a special state, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Can an actor really just pull that off for 
a shoot just because they want to...? 
Especially when we're total amateurs at 
acting.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. I appreciate Chiyono O's 
enthusiasm, but with cameras involved, it 
won't be so simple—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I. Am. O-KAY!! I have... a secret plan!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! It suits both of you so well! 
Super cute!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Thanks! You've got amazing taste 
as always, City-chan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Still, are you really sure it's okay for 
me to be a main performer too? Even if 
City-chan was the only one—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine! The way you run, 
Ines... it just hits you right here, you 
know? It's so exciting to watch!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Y-You really think so?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, you two! Are you starting to get 
hungry!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm starving. Skipping lunch 
all of a sudden, and all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, I really hope this isn't the case, 
Chiyo... but your 'secret plan' wouldn't 
happen to be—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since I joined this project, I've 
been keeping a Chiyo Notebook the whole 
time!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Looking back over it, there are all sorts 
of maxims and events noted down—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Like that story about how searching for 
food unlocked power in Tamamo-san like 
never before.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I heard this in secret, but there's a 
story about someone who was healed by 
mother nature and unusually able to free 
both body and soul."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Also, people say training at this facility 
'lets you get more immersed because it's 
wild and dangerous'!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Something happened where I wondered if 
being out in all this nature had stirred 
up my instincts."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What I'm trying to say is, I think we 
might be able to intentionally stimulate 
that instinct to a certain degree!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: In other words—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, we're doing all of this 
today! I'll keep the camera rolling the 
whole time so you can get used to it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Heightening instincts, sharpening 
them—and once fully primed!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want you to run your heart out while 
feeling all of this magnificent nature 
with your whole body!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so— the commercial shoot proposed by 
Sakura Chiyono O suddenly got underway!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, didn't that have 
so much momentum only because it was 
Tamamo-senpai?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, for now, I'll just copy it! Food, 
food, foooood...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I had no idea a place like this 
existed! City-chan, did you know about it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's my first time here. But... it's a 
nice place. Very calming.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*! —T-That was 
close...!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Don't lose your focus, City-chan! Stay on 
it, stay concentrated all the way to the 
end!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haaah!! Whoa—oop! Hup! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Haha...! I see. Now that's a good look on 
your face!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hup, whoops! Fufu, this really is so much 
fun...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...! Just keep running with everything 
you've got, Ines—!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*! This is rough... but! 
Here I goooo!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(The road ahead goes on forever! Further 
and further, beyond the horizon—!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (...I can hear my heartbeat—)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Heartbeats from long, long ago. 
...Overlapping... purely, relentlessly—)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Forward, ever forward— The throbbing 
heartbeat of those days spent racing... 
yes.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(That's why... this time for sure. I want 
to go 'beyond that'—)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —Kh!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! Haah! Haah! Haah! 
Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... Ines-senpai, are you okay? You 
were blazing through that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...! Yeah, sorry, ehehe... *pant*... 
*pant*...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...How strange.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No. Hey, City-chan... You know, I...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've loved running since a long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ever since way back then, I've always 
wanted to keep winning with everything I 
have.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
As for why, it was so obvious that I never 
even thought about it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I just…… I just naturally wanted to run, 
and I wanted to win, because, well――

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to see what lies 
"beyond"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I can tell just by looking at 
Ines. ...I can't quite put it into words, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"M-Me too...! Just a feeling, but... deep 
down in my heart, all this time—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: There's somethin' I'm chasin' after.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“......Haha! Just kiddin'. What even is 
this, anyway? This... cravin' deep down in 
my gut, y'know?”

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—That is the true instinct of an 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
It is the source of light that you have 
held within you since the day you were 
born.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The source... of the light.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, ah! The camera! I'm so sorry, 
when did I drop it?!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! No, it's fine! I captured it 
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... the video uploaded at a later 
date became quite the hot topic.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey...! If you're free this weekend, do 
you wanna check out Tracen Island?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing them race across the island moved 
many hearts— and the Umamusume returned to 
Tracen Island.
